# Reinvest

Figma: [08v. Reinvest](https://www.figma.com/design/a7Z956YZy9n6f9uz5DK16Y?node-id=6049-2) · Family: 08 Safqah-Specific · Status: stable · Version 2.0.0 · Updated 2026-10-06

Capital recycling on the first visit after the final payout: a maturity recap, then up to three open deals that match the matured deal on duration, annual return and ROI. Shown as a list (A) or a swipe carousel (B).

## Guide from the doc page

### Overview

Reinvest is the capital-recycling family. When the final payout of a deal lands, the next visit opens MaturityRecap in a BottomSheet: what came back, the breakdown, and two equal choices, reinvest or keep. Reinvest opens RecommendationList (A) or RecommendationCarousel (B) with up to three open deals that match the matured deal on duration (±4 months), annual return (±1pp) and ROI (±3pp). Matches are behavioural, never advice.

### Atomic architecture

Two new atoms: MatchStat and the Orbit illustration. Everything else is reused from Syntropy: Content (07g), CardDeal / Media (07a), KeyValue (04g), PageIndicator (07j), MoneyAmount (08d), Button (02a), with BottomSheet (06c) as the container.

MatchStat (new)

Orbit (new)

Content (07g)

CardDeal / Media (07a)

KeyValue (04g)

PageIndicator (07j)

MoneyAmount (08d)

Button (02a)

### Anatomy

RecommendationRow = Media thumb · Content (title, because line, three-factor meta) · chevron. RecommendationCard = Media · Content (title, because line) · Stats (3 × MatchStat). The organisms drop into the BottomSheet Content slot.

RecommendationRow · Media + Content + Chevron

RecommendationCard · Media + Content + 3 MatchStat

MaturityRecap · Orbit + amount + KeyValue + actions

RecommendationList · intro + 3 rows + disclaimer

### Variants & states

RecommendationCarousel: State = Card 1 / Card 2, which deal is centred (drag to change, Smart animate 300 ms). MaturityRecap: the Show withdraw boolean adds a third action for investors who prefer to cash out.

Card 1

Card 2

Show withdraw = true

### Direction - LTR & RTL

Every component mirrors: thumbnail and stat order follow reading direction, the chevron flips (Arrow-left 2 in RTL, Arrow-right 3 in LTR), text aligns to the start edge, KeyValue rows spread label and value.

LTR

RTL

### Tokens

Every colour and radius is bound to Syntropy semantic variables. Only the deal photos are raw images.

- Surfaces: rows and cards bg/surface with a 1px border/subtle stroke; MatchStat tile bg/success-subtle.
- Text: titles and the because line text/default; meta and labels text/muted; MatchStat value and the returned amount text/brand/primary (MoneyAmount Tone = brand).
- Illustration: Orbit strokes border/brand/accent, fills bg/brand/accent-100.
- Radius: rows and tiles radius/md, cards radius/lg. Gaps: 12 between rows, 8 between stat tiles, 10 inside the card.

### Accessibility

This is a money decision. Keep it calm, readable and reversible.

### Screen readers

- A row or card is one button, read as: title, because line, duration, annual return, ROI.
- The Orbit illustration is decorative and hidden from screen readers.
- The carousel announces «deal 1 of 3» and offers next / previous actions, so it never depends on dragging.

### Readability & choice

- Reinvest and Keep are equal-height buttons and both stay visible; Keep is never a small link.
- Western numerals; Arabic % labels start with «نسبة»; amounts use MoneyAmount with the SAR symbol.

> **Wording:** Never call a match «مناسبة لك» or «recommended for you» (CMA). Use the behavioural because line: «لأنها تشبه استثمارك في مدماك».

### Code examples

Flutter usage of the Reinvest family.

### Recommendation row

```dart
SafqahRecommendationRow(
  image: deal.coverImage,
  title: deal.name,
  because: match.reason, // 'Matches Madmak on all three'
  meta: '${deal.months} months · ${deal.annual}% annual · ${deal.net}% net',
  onTap: () => openDeal(deal.id, prefill: payout.capital),
)
```

### Maturity recap sheet

```dart
showSafqahBottomSheet(
  context,
  child: SafqahMaturityRecap(
    dealName: 'Madmak',
    returned: 120000,
    capital: 100000,
    profit: 20000,
    showWithdraw: false,
    onReinvest: () => showRecommendations(style: RecStyle.list),
    onKeep: () => Navigator.of(context).pop(),
  ),
);
```

### Usage - Do & Don’t

Do

Show at most three matches, each with its because line and the three factors: duration, annual return, ROI.

Don’t

Don’t hide Keep or shrink it to a link. Reinvest and Keep are equal choices; the investor decides.

Do

Prefill the deal page with the capital only (100,000). The profit stays in the wallet.

Don’t

Don’t rank or label deals as «best for you». Order by match closeness and say why.

### Notes from the maintainer

> **Three factors only:** Duration ±4 months, annual return ±1pp, ROI ±3pp, always against the matured deal. No developer, city or ticket-size matching.

> **The final payout is not trackable yet:** repayment_completed fires about 1.7× per investment with no is_final flag. Ship the instrumentation first or the sheet fires on partial payouts.
